title: MARQ-Bench: Machine-Authored Rule Quality — benchmark, harness, and rule corpus

creators.name: Kallam, Ramesh Babu
creators.affiliation: Independent Researcher, Cloud Data Engineering, West Chester, Ohio 45069, United States

description:
Reproducibility artefact for No Single Source Suffices: Documentation and Profiling Prevent Different Failures in Machine-Authored Data Quality Rules.

Contains the MARQ-Bench harness (rule intermediate representation, prompt construction across four information conditions, corpus profiling, provider-agnostic generation, failure coding, downstream and fairness evaluation), the full pipeline as executable notebooks, 137 tests, the corpus of 7,609 machine-authored rules with failure codes and retention, the complete raw model responses, and all analysis outputs and figures.

All analysis in the paper can be reproduced from the released outputs without an API key.
